sourceFile: 19. BRS-161014  Report test CMG and CPT reduce dimension + NTI data 17.2.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid main Normal/Test evidence but misstates the changed factor and several measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor should center on reduced CMG/CPT or yoke dimensions, not supplier/material.
Gauss Normal rows are not grouped by MG+PT vs Semi Yoke.
FO outcomes are mis-extracted from labels instead of comparing actual values and averages.
NTI outcomes cite mostly header rows and include non-condition columns as stats.
Review title and metric names contain raw row text and typos.
correctionPlan: Set primary change to reduced dimension Test/Test Yoke versus Normal and remove unsupported domains.
Preserve gauss subgroups: MG+PT and Semi Yoke with their specs and OK result.
Rebuild FO as one measurement comparison using rows 5-15 and the AVG row.
Exclude or rebuild NTI SPL/THD/IMP only with data and average rows, not headers alone.
Use concise normalized title, purpose, metrics, and limitations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Main NG/function citations are sufficient; measurement citations need data and average rows, not headers only.
